missions.name: FOCUSED FIRE
missions.objective: Have at least 3 friendly units target one enemy unit with attacks or abilities in a single Action Phase.

discarded.name: ASSASSINATION
discarded.objective: Destroy an enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER.

primary.name: RAISE THE STANDARD
primary.objective: After choosing this card, plant your standard on a square at least 3 squares from your deployment zone and from every objective, outside the enemy deployment zone. At the end of each Battle Round, score 1 VP if a friendly unit is within 1 square of the standard and no enemy unit is, or 2 VP if the standard stands in the enemy half. Score 1 VP more if you also held it at the end of the previous Battle Round. If an enemy unit is within 1 square of it and no friendly unit is at the end of a Battle Round, it is torn down for good.

missions.name: TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET
missions.objective: When you keep this mission, your opponent picks an objective outside their deployment zone. At the end of a Battle Round, control that objective.

discarded.name: LAST STAND
discarded.objective: At the end of a Battle Round, control an objective that has a friendly unit Below Half-Strength in its Objective Area.

primary.name: LEAD FROM THE FRONT
primary.objective: At the end of each Battle Round, score 2 VP if a friendly CHARACTER, or a friendly squad a CHARACTER has joined, is in an Objective Area or the enemy half of the battlefield. Score 3 VP instead if two or more are.
